title: F-GC17 Typed Direct Groundwater Interface Canonical Admission
admission_contract: Compose only the exact qualified F-GC17 source postimage onto current canonical.
Preserve explicit H=z+psi common-datum semantics for direct mode-5 coupling.
Preserve qbot cm/day positive-into-SWAP to q_SWAP m/s positive-out conversion and exact q_GW=-q_SWAP assignment.
Preserve explicit provenance-bound head tolerance with no numeric default.
Keep head convergence separate from application H_app, temporal H_budget, solver tolerance and mass conservation.
Do not admit predictor-corrector orchestration, groundwater service, mass ledger, tile aggregation, MODFLOW adapter or deep-vadose physics.
required_gates: independent compile and contract replay at O0 and O2
head and flux conversion round trips
fail-closed tolerance provenance and non-finite inputs
defect_rule: Any source defect or required semantic change returns to F-GC17 ownership; F-CI50 may not patch production behavior opportunistically.
promotion_rule: Promote only by a true two-parent merge after exact-head qualification and only if integration/f-ci-canonical remains exactly the frozen canonical base.
